title: Enhancement: Update Nexthop x86_64-nexthop_4220-r0 temperature thresholds
author: antonio-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

To align `sensors.conf` with hardware functional spec

### Current Behavior

`sensors.conf` values are not aligned with hardware functional spec

### Proposed Behavior

`sensors.conf` should use values from hardware functional spec

linkedPullRequests.title: [Nexthop] Align x86_64-nexthop_4220-r0 sensors.conf with HWFS
